scenario: Aggregate buckets, daily activity summaries, and a profile snapshot
notes: Two aggregate buckets (one with a value and temporal contexts, one explicit-null 'empty bucket'), two activity summaries (one with localDate and temporal context, one legacy-style with only the epoch-ms date and null rings, keyed by the UTC date of 'date', 2024-06-11), and a profile line that clears name and email while setting date of birth and sex. Aggregates and summaries are upserts; a replay overwrites the same rows. 'state' is the stored ring rows after this fixture; fixture 08 replaces the first.
